environment: Local repository-native Stage 10 Cycle Review assessment synthesis
constraints: no Git or remote mutation without separate authorization

selected.tool: No external tool; repository-native evidence synthesis
selected.role: Six-dimension Cycle Review assessment synthesis and schema-bound materialization

selection_rationale: Task 10.012 is a bounded synthesis of already frozen repository evidence under an explicit local JSON schema and strict human gate boundaries. No external system adds required evidence or authority. Repository-native synthesis minimizes disclosure and mutation surface while preserving direct evidence references.
risks: The fit score is a contextual task-selection heuristic, not empirical tool-performance evidence.
Assessment readiness must not be interpreted as G-P10 pass.
Public repository accessibility must not be interpreted as public-safe classification.
human_controls: Human review is required before the Task 10.012 assessment can be frozen.
A later explicit human decision owns G-P10.
No new cycle may start automatically.
Strategy and WIP must remain unchanged.
Git and remote actions require separate explicit authorization.
official_sources: No external tool documentation required for the selected no-external-tool path.
curation_source: task.skillcertify.10.012 canonical registry, cycle-review-assessment schema, frozen Stage 10 dependency evidence, and Task 10.012 publication-state reconciliation
